attackWeights.note: Weights per phase among the attacks whose band contains the player; the same attack never starts three times running; the eruption is favoured when the player is inside closeDistance or after three consecutive hits taken, and opens phase two. The fissure is the only attack with a band past 3.35 m, so backing off is no longer safe. Distances are authored metres. 13 Oct 2026: the delayed slam (slam band) and the pillars (3.2-10 authored metres, the far answer beside the fissure) join both phases.

burst.source: the approved slam clip: at 2.36 s the blade bottoms out in front and the pose holds until 3.3 s; dark fire erupts in a ring (radial distance check, no blade geometry) while the boss is planted, then the clip's own recovery backstep
burst.leapSource: 13 Oct 2026 (user: 'when he does the area attack on the floor I'd like him to jump, Dark Souls / Elden Ring style'): the eruption became a leaping slam. The slam clip runs to 1.6 s (the scythe cocked over his left shoulder) while he sinks into a crouch, springs at 1.6, hangs in the air while clip 1.6-2.05 raises the scythe overhead (1.0 s), drops through the chop (clip 2.05-2.3 in .3 s) and lands at 2.9 as the blade bottoms out; the ring erupts on the landing, the knees absorb it, then the clip's own planted hold and recovery. Flight .96 s wall, apex 2.6 m (14 Oct 2026, user: jump higher; was 1.6 m over .85 s), landing locked at take-off 1.6 m short of the player (at most 3 m away); band widened to 4.2 m to give the leap room. Lift, crouch, tuck and travel: src/game/boss-leap.js. All lengths authored metres.

fissure.source: Round 3 (16 Sep 2026 evening, graphics + boss pass): the approved slam clip planted (2.36 s, the blade bottoms out in front) and a fissure of dark fire tears along the floor from the plant point along the boss's facing - reach 7.4 authored metres crossed in .6 clip seconds (`travel`), a line `width` wide; hit by line geometry (encounter.js linearContact), not by blade contact. The one attack whose band reaches past the slam's 3.35 m, so a player who backs off gets a line to sidestep instead of a boss who walks. Inspiration: the line casts of github.com/achrefelouafi/LinearAbiltyCastingThreeJS.

delayedSlam.source: 13 Oct 2026 (user: more boss abilities, 'Golpe retrasado'): the approved slam clip played to 1.9 s, where the scythe is cocked high behind him, then crept 1.9 -> 1.98 over 1.1 s (a held, trembling raise instead of a dead freeze), then the rest of the clip. The blade's clip hit window [2.136, 2.357] moves by the hold (+1.02 s); contact is still blade geometry. Tip trajectory from scripts/measure-boss-reach.mjs. A Souls delayed swing: a roll timed to the raise lands in the hold.

pillars.source: 13 Oct 2026 (user: more boss abilities, 'Pilares de fuego'): the approved slam clip. Rings of coals follow the player through the windup; when the scythe is planted (lockAt 2.36 s) they lock to the floor, and when he wrenches it free (3.3 s, the end of the clip's planted hold) columns of dark fire erupt there - about .75 s to step out (.65 s in phase two). One pillar in phase one; in phase two three in a row across the boss-to-player line, so a sidestep is not enough. reach = pillar radius; pillars = [side, ahead] offsets; all authored metres.
